node.statement: From def-compressed-corner there is a universal c_co such that Co_{U,V} differs from each parenthesization U(XV) and (UX)V by at most c_co e||X|| whenever U,V have the stated projection accuracy; hence X in S_{U,V} implies X=U(XV)+O(e)||X||. The epsilon-C*-algebra product bound, associator bound, involution, and uniform bounds on the projections permit all fixed-length replacements below with one universal accumulated constant.
